title: isdeployed
summary: Return false because RunMat is not MATLAB Compiler deployed code.
description: `isdeployed` returns a logical scalar indicating whether code is running as a MATLAB Compiler deployed application. RunMat always returns false.
behaviors: The builtin accepts no input arguments.
The result is always false in RunMat.

faqs.question: Can RunMat run MATLAB Compiler deployed code?
faqs.answer: No. This predicate exists so compatibility branches can execute deterministically.

gpu_residency: The result is a host logical scalar.
